title: LumenGuard
description: Intelligent torch management for your off-hand.
body:
# 🔦 LumenGuard
LumenGuard is an intelligent, lightweight, and client-side utility designed to manage torch placement in Minecraft. It removes the frustration of accidental torch placement while keeping your builds clean and efficient.

## 🔥 Key Features
Smart Anti-Spam: Prevents accidental torch placement in already well-lit areas by detecting light levels.

* Smart Refund: Automatically returns the torch to your inventory if an placement is blocked, so you don't lose resources.

* Environment Aware: Perfectly distinguishes between day and night, and intelligently detects if you are inside a dark cave, even during the day!

* Decorative Override: Need to place a torch for decoration? Just hold Shift (Sneak) to bypass the system and place it anywhere.

* Full 6-Side Support: Detects placement on ground, floor, and all four walls accurately.

* Vanilla-Friendly Feedback: Features subtle smoke particles and a satisfying wooden-click sound when a placement is blocked.

* Creative Mode Fix: Automatically disables resource refunding in Creative mode to prevent item duplication bugs.

### 🛠️ Technical Details

* Loader: Client-side only (No server-side installation required).

* Compatibility: Works perfectly on vanilla servers.

### 💡 Why use LumenGuard?
Unlike other mods that blindly block your clicks, LumenGuard thinks for you. It ensures your mining trips are efficient, your inventory is managed, and your builds stay exactly as you designed them.

Created by sidyasinX using MCreator.
